prior_exposure: Campaigns 40-42 and two ChatGPT reviews are exposed. Jev ranked a short bilateral sensory tape perturbation; ChatGPT proposed a distinct virtual yaw perturbation of 2 degrees. This is a CPU codifier preflight only, not a blinded neural test.
limitation_observed: The mirrored source contrast reaches DNb05 but produces only 0.057746766 degrees paired command difference in 400 ms; the 2-s trajectory worsens after wind even if recorded raw command replaces relay output. Whether the sensor is locally informative about an incremental orientation error at the postwind state is unknown.

A_virtual_orientation.operation: Hold full body pose except rotate the free-root yaw by 2 degrees away from the fixed right source only for CPU olfactory sampling, then restore. Compare actual antenna geometry and effective L/R concentration at trial ms1000 and1020.
A_virtual_orientation.information: Saved qpos, frozen model and source/sigma; source is evaluator information, never a CNS input.
A_virtual_orientation.falsifier: The rotation fails to increase signed bearing error, or changes neither consumed L/R channel nor contrast above the predeclared numerical floor at both poses.

B_mirrored_sensory_tape.operation: At a shared checkpoint, swap left/right olfactory samples for a short neural continuation with body/proprioceptive tape fixed.
B_mirrored_sensory_tape.information: Recorded bilateral samples and shared checkpoint only; no source bearing injected into CNS.
B_mirrored_sensory_tape.falsifier: The valid intervention is consumed but does not change the downstream raw-command contrast in the fixed horizon.

C_online_body_yaw.operation: Perturb the physical yaw and let actual sensors/body/CNS close the loop in a short continuation after an exact same-start control.
C_online_body_yaw.information: Own physical state and sensors only; evaluator computes error.
C_online_body_yaw.falsifier: No corrective behavioral/neural difference beyond matched physical passive effects; costly and confounded by proprioception/contact changes.

preflight_choice: A is screened before constructing a neural runner. B and C remain distinct alternatives; the preflight does not promote A or forbid B/C.

checks.criterion_scope: The concentration floors are only a codifier observability screen; they do not predict DN or navigation effect. No threshold is retuned after output.

stop: After two frozen poses. If geometry identity or numerical checks fail, mark uninterpretable; if sensor change fails the floor, do not launch the 2-degree neural continuation. A separate prospective contract is required for any neural run.
